attack.note: The game labels him ranged, but he plays as a dive assassin. Shuriken poke is a minor tool and best from point blank (Shingan needs all three to hit). Dragonblade makes him melee for 8 seconds. Basic attacks matter mostly with Way Of The Shimada.

poke.note: Three Shuriken in a spread, 12 second shared recharge, easy to sidestep from range. Shuriken Mastery and Shingan reward point blank use, which is a dive, not poke.

damage.note: Swift Strike (190) resets on a kill, Dragonblade (240 slash), X-Strike (145 plus 290) and Final Cut come in bursts and kill squishy targets before healing matters. Measured: hero damage per minute only about 2600 against a median of 2060, siege is the lowest of the batch at about 2950, damage taken is high at about 2360, takedowns the highest at 10.9 per game. He is a pick and kill hero, not a sustained damage dealer.

good_into.why: Swift Strike, Cyber Agility and Dragonblade reach a squishy ranged hero in seconds, and a kill resets Swift Strike so he can chain into the next target.
Teams full of ranged heroes have little to peel him, and Deflect blocks and returns their damage while he dives.
Targets that cannot dodge Swift Strike or Dragonblade are dead, and X-Strike has maximum damage on a stunned or rooted target.
Deflect blocks a large share of poke damage for 1.25 seconds and Augmented Guard turns it into a shield, then he dives the poker.

bad_into.why: Stun, root or silence takes away both Swift Strike and Cyber Agility, and he has no Unstoppable. The guide names Varian's Taunt and Malfurion's Twilight Dream.
Mobile ranged assassins like Lunara can bait him into overextending and poison keeps ticking through Deflect.
Point and click crowd control from heroes such as Uther cancels a dive on a backline target, and a burst healer undoes a failed kill.
Low health pool and Deflect with a 16 second cooldown means a faster assassin with burst can kill him in return.

wants_from_team: Burst damage and crowd control that lets him finish a single target (Jaina, Kael'thas)
A burst healer that gives armor or invulnerability like Uther
Crowd control already used by the enemy before he commits
Tank frontline that pulls enemy attention and cooldowns
gives_team: Backline pick potential and execute resets
Deflect that shuts down channelled or fast attacks of the enemy
Mobility to cross walls and flank
weaknesses: Low health and needs constant healing
High skill floor, needs enemy crowd control to be spent
evidence: Swift Strike reset, Cyber Agility, Deflect
Icy Veins counters text (Varian, Malfurion, Lunara, Uther)
Measured block: damage per minute about 2600, siege about 2950, damage taken about 2360, takedowns 10.9 per game, win rate 0.522 over 722 games
owner_notes: A dive burst assassin who bursts down a vulnerable backline. Escapes well, but is susceptible to CC and has low health.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Owner read: burst dive assassin. Swift Strike, Dragonblade, X-Strike and Final Cut do most of the damage, autos are weak.
lens_notes.damage_reach: Shuriken pokes at range but he fights in melee with Swift Strike and Dragonblade.
lens_notes.setup_reliance: Swift Strike resets only on a kill, so he waits for a wounded target. Icy Veins says to wait for enemy CC to be spent.
lens_notes.escape: Owner read: escapes well. Cyber Agility, Swift Strike and Deflect.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Agile Dismount adds a slow on landing as a talent only.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Deflect makes him Protected for 1.25 seconds. Cyber Shield dodges a heroic attack. Dragonblade can still be stunned.
lens_notes.vision_stealth: Pathfinder stealth is only over terrain jumps, a talent.
lens_notes.wave_clear_style: Measured siege is the lowest at 2950 per minute against 4430.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Dragonblade is a swing. X-Strike is a burst plus escape alternative.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Owner read: susceptible to CC and low health. Mana hungry, so poke wears him down.
lens_notes.durability_source: Deflect is a damage window, otherwise low health. Damage taken of 2360 per minute is high from diving.

lens_gaps: no value on kill_pattern or damage_delivery for dash and reset heroes (Swift Strike resets on kill), the lens says backline_dive only
no lens for mana dependence (Genji is mana hungry), vulnerable_to has no mana pressure value
